title: sarcoglottis thelymitra
intro: Sarcoglottis thelymitra, commonly known as the Butterfly Orchid, is a species of orchid plant in the family Orchidaceae. The plant has been found to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Sarcoglottis thelymitra include its antioxidant and antiseptic properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and infection. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
